outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your practice pages
outreach_draft.body:
Calvin,

I noticed PT Law handles three very different kinds of matters—personal injury, criminal defense and immigration—but they still share the same general Practice Areas experience on the site.

Those clients are arriving with completely different questions. Someone trying to understand an immigration path needs a different conversation from someone dealing with a car accident or a criminal charge.

Dedicated pages for each main practice could:
- speak directly to that type of client
- give Google a focused page to crawl and index
- give AI tools clearer context about each part of the firm’s work

Immigration already has useful substance on the site, so I’m using that as the first mockup example—not because it is the only practice that could benefit.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
